notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
It's awhile since release and I want to give an update on the things I wanted to add. 

Achievements are implemented and working, if you have any problems with them please let me know.

 The Spanish version has taken longer to get made than expected because my Spanish speaking friend had some things come up that has taken a massive portion of her time. It's also her vacation week next week so it may be awhile before she gets back to me and I have time to implement everything. 

After seeing it in game I did not add the additional music track. It breaks the flow of the game too much and just did not feel right. 

The versions for Mac and Linux are sadly not going to make it. I thought I could fix the problems that prevented me from releasing with them however in the end was not able to.
